summary: Frontend-only iteration 40. Verified EMI Calculator page (/emi-calculator), Calculate EMI CTA chip on ongoing project detail pages, company email surfacing across Contact and Footer, and nav/mobile/footer sitemap entries. All targeted acceptance criteria pass; zero console errors on covered routes.
verified_changes: EMI defaults (₹50,00,000 / 8.5% / 20yrs): monthly=₹43,391, principal=₹50,00,000, interest=₹54,13,879, total=₹1,04,13,879 — MATCHES expected values exactly (Indian ₹ formatting with lakh/crore grouping confirmed).
Instant recalc: setting amount=75,00,000 immediately updates monthly EMI to ₹65,087 (no submit needed).
Tenure unit toggle: switching to months converts 20 yrs → 240 mo; switching back → 20 yrs. Values preserved.
Edge cases: rate=1% works (75L/20yr = ₹34,492). amount 999999999 clamps to 50,000,000 (₹5Cr max). amount 100 clamps to 500,000 (₹5L min).
URL prefill: /emi-calculator?amount=7500000 initializes amount input to 7500000 and monthly EMI shows ₹65,087.
Aurelia (ongoing) CTA: [data-testid=calculate-emi-cta] href=/emi-calculator?amount=7500000 (₹5,994 × 1250 sft = 74,92,500 rounded to nearest lakh = ₹75L). Click navigates to prefilled calculator.

All 6 ongoing project detail pages show the CTA with correct prefill:
  - my-dream-aurelia: amount=7500000 (1250 sft)
  - my-dream-elysium: amount=7500000 (1250 sft)
  - my-dream-aura:    amount=10100000 (1680 sft → 100,69,920 → 1,01,00,000)
  - my-dream-echelon: amount=7100000 (1180 sft)
  - my-dream-vale:    amount=10000000 (1665 sft → 99,79,010 → 1,00,00,000)
  - my-dream-ivy:     amount=9600000  (1600 sft → 95,90,400 → 96,00,000)
All 13 completed project detail pages do NOT render calculate-emi-cta (verified nest, casa, avasa, skylark, glenmore, hillock, summit, griffin, selene, atlantis, perch, solace, zenith).
Desktop nav order: Home → Projects → EMI Calculator → Our Map → About → Contact (EMI Calculator sits between Projects and Our Map as required). Active state highlights when on /emi-calculator.
mobile-nav-emi-link present in mobile hamburger menu; footer-emi-link present in footer sitemap.

Company email surfaced correctly at three locations (all with href=mailto:adminmydreamprojects@gmail.com and visible text adminmydreamprojects@gmail.com): contact-email-link, contact-form-email-link, footer-email-link.
Founder phones UNCHANGED: Nimmala Sai +91 77804 29845, Kotapati Akhil +91 95660 67922 (both still present on /contact and in footer).
Responsive: /emi-calculator at 390px and 834px — no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == viewport width).

Regression sweep zero console errors on: /, /projects, /projects/my-dream-nest, /projects/my-dream-ivy, /about, /contact, /emi-calculator. (/project-map not asserted here because networkidle waits on live Google Maps iframe; but no errors captured during its partial load — pre-existing behavior noted in iteration 39.)
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In EmiCalculator.jsx, when tenure unit toggles years→months by multiplying by 12, values above 30*12=360 are clamped to 360 correctly; when toggling months→years with a value that rounds to 0, LIMITS.years.min=1 also clamps. Robust.

Nit: The URL prefill only reads searchParams once at init (useState lazy init). If a user navigates from one ongoing project to /emi-calculator?amount=X and then to another via a Link, React Router replaces params but the state won't reset. Not in scope for this iteration but worth noting if future flows chain multiple prefill navigations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EMI Calculator + email additions are fully working on preview URL https://premium-residential-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Regression on prior features (project pages, elevations, plans, map, hero slideshow) untouched by this iteration and previously verified in iteration 39. Note: /project-map times out under Playwright wait_until='networkidle' because the Google Maps iframe keeps open connections — use 'domcontentloaded' for future navigations to that route.
